title: A finite surjective morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme gives a coherent sheaf whose pushforward is supported on a given integral closed subscheme
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], with $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $\xi\in X$ be the point whose closure $\overline{\{\xi\}}$ is $i(Z)$ (the generic point of $Z$). Then there is a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] such that the direct image $f_*\mathcal F$, $(f_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(f^{-1}U)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], satisfies $\operatorname{Supp}(f_*\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:(f_*\mathcal F)_x\neq0\}=i(Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2), with stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and $\mathfrak m_\xi\,(f_*\mathcal F)_\xi=0$, where $\mathfrak m_\xi$ is the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ [def-weil-residue-field].
